name: Cross-Reprojection Attention
definition: A two-stage attention mechanism (intra-view radial and cross-view sparse) that approximates dense semantic connections in 3D space by reprojecting query rays to source views and aggregating features, solving the insufficiency of single-point feature extraction for semantic prediction.
summary: Cross-Reprojection Attention is a two-stage mechanism that reduces computational cost by reprojecting query rays to source views for feature aggregation instead of using dense multi-view attention.
